test_title: RRB Technician Grade 1 19 Dec 2024 Shift 1 Official Paper
subject: general
question:
Read the given statement and conclusions carefully and decide which of the given conclusions follow(s) from the statement.

**Statement:**

Book-reading is a very healthy habit because it keeps our learning process alive even after our college or school education.

**Conclusions:**

I. Nowadays, e-books are gaining far more popularity than hardcovers.

II. Students gain a lot of knowledge and improve language by keeping the habit of book-reading alive.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
Given statement: Book-reading is a very healthy habit because it keeps our learning process alive even after our college or school education.

Given conclusions:

I. Nowadays, e-books are gaining far more popularity than hardcovers. → Does not follow

The statement is regarding book reading as a habit instead of format e-books v/s hardcovers, thus the given conclusion is not related to the given statement.

II. Students gain a lot of knowledge and improve language by keeping the habit of book-reading alive. → Follow

The given conclusion supports the idea of book-reading, gaining knowledge and improving language are reasonable effects of book-reading.

Thus, Only Conclusion II follows.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
